description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {1}
Mirran Spy and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Mirran Spy trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
